# ADD_SUB_LEGO — Add a sub-LEGO inside an existing LEGO

## Prerequisites

- Nesting depth after the change is <= 3 (deeper needs Manager approval)
- The parent genuinely composes it rather than merely calling it

## Steps

1. Add a domain entry with `parent` set to the containing LEGO.
2. Put it under the parent path so `domainForPath` resolves it.
3. List sibling sub-LEGOs in `mustNotDependOn` — siblings talk through the parent.
4. If the parent depends on it, add `requires` with a version range so R9 checks compatibility.
5. Regenerate the AI pack.

## Required tests

- `npm run lego:arch:selftest`
- `cd apps/n8n-lego && node --test test/lego-lifecycle.test.mjs`

## Merge gate

Depth <= 3 and gate green

## Rollback condition

Remove the entry; the parent is unaffected because it only used the contract.
